stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The specification defines the size and shape of each part.
items.sentenceZh: 规格说明规定了每个零件的大小和形状。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese design workshop, an adult engineer compares three manufactured parts against a blank illustrated specification sheet with matching silhouettes and dimension arrows but no numbers; one part fits the prescribed outline while two are visibly set aside for adjustment. Show precise requirements guiding fabrication, natural hands and fully drawn face, no text or logos.
items.altText: 中国设计工作室中，工程师按规格轮廓检查零件尺寸和形状。

items.sentenceEn: The warm cup gave her a pleasant sensation in her hands.
items.sentenceZh: 温暖的杯子让她的双手感到舒适。
items.scene: An adult woman in a contemporary Chinese tea house gently holds a warm plain ceramic cup with both hands; subtle soft concentric warmth ripples near her fingertips convey tactile sensation while her fully drawn face shows quiet comfort. No hot spill, burns, mystical aura, tea branding, text or logos.
items.altText: 茶馆里，女子双手捧着温暖的陶杯，感受杯壁传来的暖意。

items.sentenceEn: The team completed the feature during a short sprint.
items.sentenceZh: 团队在一次短迭代中完成了这项功能。
items.scene: A small product team moves a limited set of colored task cards through a circular short work cycle ending in one completed feature block; a longer project road continues beyond it, making a bounded agile sprint distinct from a running race. Fully illustrated adult faces and hands; no writing, numbers, readable board or logos.
items.altText: 产品团队在一轮短周期内推进任务卡并完成一个功能模块。

items.sentenceEn: The window was partially covered by the curtain.
items.sentenceZh: 窗帘只遮住了窗户的一部分。
items.scene: One large window has a curtain drawn across exactly the left half while sunlight enters through the clearly visible uncovered right half; simple interior objects show the difference between covered and exposed areas. No people, lettering, numbers or logos.
items.altText: 窗帘只遮住窗户左半部分，阳光从右半部分照入。

items.sentenceEn: The team tested the update in staging before release.
items.sentenceZh: 团队在发布前先于预发布环境测试了更新。
items.scene: Two visually similar app environments stand side by side; a small updated component is tested in a clearly separate rehearsal environment while the public environment remains in use, with a gated path from test to release. No theater stage, people, code, readable screens, text, labels, numbers or logos.
items.altText: 更新先在与正式系统相似的隔离预发布环境中测试。

items.sentenceEn: The syntax determines how the pieces must be arranged.
items.sentenceZh: 语法规定这些部分应如何排列。
items.scene: Colored abstract language tokens are fitted into a precise left-to-right structural frame; one sequence fits all slots and an alternate misplaced token does not, emphasizing arrangement rules rather than meaning. No actual letters, words, code, labels, numbers or faces.
items.altText: 不同形状的语言符号按规定顺序进入句法框架。

items.sentenceEn: The tensor stores values across several dimensions.
items.sentenceZh: 张量在多个维度上组织数值。
items.scene: A clear three-dimensional lattice of small colored cells, arranged as stacked two-dimensional grids, makes multidimensional structured values visible; three mutually perpendicular directions are implied by spatial axes without written symbols. No neural network, people, digits, letters, labels or code.
items.altText: 数层二维彩色网格堆叠成三维张量结构。

items.sentenceEn: She carried the blanket upstairs to the bedroom.
items.sentenceZh: 她把毯子拿到楼上的卧室。
items.scene: A cutaway two-story home shows an adult carrying a folded blanket safely up a staircase from the lower living room toward the bedroom directly above; one hand lightly uses the rail, face fully drawn. Clear vertical destination, no fall, clutter, text or numbers.
items.altText: 女子拿着毯子沿楼梯走向上层卧室。

items.sentenceEn: The dried tea leaves were ready for storage.
items.sentenceZh: 晒干的茶叶可以入库存放了。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese tea cooperative, an adult worker carefully gathers crisp fully dried tea leaves from clean drying trays into an airtight unmarked container; fresh moist leaves on a separate nearby tray provide a clear before-and-after comparison, natural hands, fully illustrated face, no brand, writing or text.
items.altText: 中国茶叶合作社工人把已干燥的茶叶从晾晒盘装入容器。

items.sentenceEn: She used a terminal to send a command to the server.
items.sentenceZh: 她通过终端向服务器发送指令。
items.scene: An adult operator at a simple keyboard-and-display terminal sends one abstract command token along a cable to a separate server, which returns a colored response token to the display; the terminal is clearly the human input-output endpoint. Display contains only blank geometric blocks, no command text, code, letters, numbers or logos; full illustrated face and natural hands.
items.altText: 操作员通过键盘和显示终端向服务器发送指令并接收回应。

items.sentenceEn: The wider channel increased the system's throughput.
items.sentenceZh: 更宽的通道提高了系统吞吐量。
items.scene: Two processing channels are compared during identical short intervals marked by blank hourglass silhouettes: the narrow channel delivers a small group of colored tokens, while the wider channel delivers visibly many more tokens in the same interval; focus on amount completed per time, no rate numbers, text, people or pipes carrying water.
items.altText: 同样时间内，较宽的处理通道输出更多数据块。

items.sentenceEn: The request ended in a timeout when no reply arrived.
items.sentenceZh: 迟迟没有回应，请求最终超时结束。
items.scene: A request capsule travels from a client toward a distant server but no response returns before a plain hourglass empties; a simple boundary gate closes the waiting path at that moment, emphasizing the expired waiting period without implying server failure cause. No people, error text, clocks with numbers, code or labels.
items.altText: 请求发出后未及时收到回应，等待时间耗尽，通道关闭。

items.sentenceEn: Conservation helped protect the wetland birds.
items.sentenceZh: 保护工作帮助守护湿地鸟类。
items.scene: A Chinese wetland conservation team restores native reeds and maintains a marked quiet buffer around nesting waterbirds, observing from a distant boardwalk; natural adult faces, bird anatomy, respectful distance, no handling of nests, national slogans, flags, text or signs.
items.altText: 中国湿地保护人员修复芦苇栖息地并远距离守护水鸟。

items.sentenceEn: The token let the app access one protected resource.
items.sentenceZh: 令牌让应用访问一项受保护的资源。
items.scene: An application presents one small unique abstract access token to a gate; the gate checks its matching shape and opens only the path to one protected resource compartment, with other compartments still closed. No people, authentication code, password, text, letters, numbers, security guarantee or logos.
items.altText: 应用出示一个令牌后，仅获准进入匹配的资源空间。

items.sentenceEn: He gave the heavy crate a shove to move it across the floor.
items.sentenceZh: 他猛推了一下重箱子，让它在地板上移动。
items.scene: An adult warehouse worker uses both hands to give one sturdy crate a strong short push across a clear smooth floor; motion streaks show the crate has just moved while the worker keeps a stable stance. No pushing a person, injury, unsafe lifting, labels, text or logos; full illustrated face and natural hands.
items.altText: 工人稳稳站立，用双手猛推箱子使其滑过地面。

items.sentenceEn: Unix coordinates several users and tasks on the server.
items.sentenceZh: Unix 在服务器上协调多个用户和任务。
items.scene: A mature cutaway server illustration shows a central operating-system kernel scheduling several separate task streams from multiple user workstations while coordinating storage and devices; a clean layered architecture distinguishes it from a single application. No trademark logo, mascot, command line, code, letters, numbers, labels or screens.
items.altText: 服务器中央的操作系统内核协调多个用户任务与设备。

items.sentenceEn: The family planted herbs in the backyard.
items.sentenceZh: 一家人在后院种下了香草。
items.scene: Behind a contemporary Chinese townhouse, an adult family tends a small private backyard herb garden bounded by the rear house wall and fence; front street is only faintly visible beyond the house so the rear location is clear. Fully illustrated faces, natural hands, no stereotypes, text or signs.
items.altText: 中国城市住宅的后院里，一家人照料小片香草园。

items.sentenceEn: The server maintained high uptime throughout the week.
items.sentenceZh: 这台服务器整周保持了很高的正常运行时间。
items.scene: A server continuously sends steady output pulses across a long horizontal sequence of blank day panels, with only one tiny inactive gap shown as a small break; make duration of availability clear without statistics or guarantee. No people, percentages, digits, clocks, labels or text.
items.altText: 服务器在连续多日中几乎始终保持稳定运行。

items.sentenceEn: The organization adopted a charter defining its purpose.
items.sentenceZh: 该组织通过了一份阐明宗旨的章程。
items.scene: A fictional community organization formally approves a blank illustrated charter document at a meeting; an abstract emblem of shared purpose sits at its center and several adult representatives place plain seals around it, showing an adopted founding document rather than a casual note. No real government marks, readable writing, logos or flags; complete drawn faces and hands.
items.altText: 虚构社区组织的代表共同通过并盖章确认一份章程。

items.sentenceEn: The project team listened to every stakeholder before redesigning the park.
items.sentenceZh: 项目团队在改造公园前听取了各方相关者的意见。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese neighborhood park planning table, residents, a wheelchair user, a gardener, a nearby shop owner, and project staff contribute to the same blank physical park model; each has a distinct practical interest in the redesign, equal voice, adult faces and natural hands, no tokenism, political signs, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国社区公园改造前，居民、商户、园丁和项目人员一起讨论模型。
